COURSES.Description: This course is an introduction to current cybersecurity issues and trends in business and industry. Students install and configure software and tools used to ensure personal, Internet, mobile, and computer security. | Contact: Class 2 Lab 2 | Format: Online | Grading: Attendance 10%; NetAcad 15%; Intro to Modern AI 5%; Weekly tasks 35%; Capstone 35% | Course build: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1gRFtm9Lql6nUUTPhZIvtXCx1riFofAauXMFqi4Bf1cc/edit | Evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Z_oi0bBXWenLoLSS07IvG78VGHqusmLr

This course examines the basic commands and features of personal computer (PC) operating systems. Students learn to install, setup, configure and troubleshoot DOS, Windows and Linux operating systems. Students also examine the architecture of mainframe and PCs, including hardware components of a PC and how they interact. Installing, configuring, and troubleshooting PC hardware and software are covered. | Contact: Class 1 Lab 4 | Format: In person | Grading: Attendance 10%; MindTap 10%; NetAcad 5%; Labs 30%; Midterm 15%; Capstone 30% | Course build: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1mHSJF6_aEHfGEb_CMRNb2x0g-CWvUz-4AckUochTgKc/edit | Evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1FGH-DW3XzvZ-XwsJLZL-eNaQ39e_G2vs

Introduces the architecture, structure, functions, components, and models of the Internet and other computer networks. The principles and structure of IP addressing and the fundamentals of Ethernet concepts, media, and operations are introduced to provide a foundation for the curriculum. | Contact: Class 2 Lab 4 | Format: In person | Grading: Attendance 10%; MindTap 10%; NetAcad 5%; Labs 30%; Midterm 15%; Capstone 30% | Course build: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1QLyEjwVS_tcndJ4-5lf5HVby4Zagu1uQaxwrNmkSCnY/edit | Evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1m7lXJkmpUpAP3bz-pVgVCZwWn6e73pKM

PLOS.PLO Statement: Design, implement, secure, and manage modern technology environments including networks, systems, and infrastructure.
Manage, analyze, and interpret data to support security operations and organizational decision-making.
Apply cybersecurity principles, risk management practices, and security controls to protect digital assets and organizational operations.
Analyze and resolve technical and security challenges using critical thinking, industry-standard tools, and applied methodologies.
Demonstrate ethical, legal, and professional responsibility, including the responsible and verified use of artificial intelligence.
Communicate technical information, findings, and recommendations effectively to technical and non-technical audiences.

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Install, configure, secure, and maintain Windows and Linux server systems in on-premises, virtualized, cloud, and hybrid environments.
COURSE_CLOS.Assessment Method: Capstone: Secure Server Environment Plan, Build & Documentation
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: NET-2220 course build; maps to PLO 1

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Configure and administer users, groups, permissions, authentication, directory services, policies, and other identity and access controls within enterprise server environments.
COURSE_CLOS.Assessment Method: Capstone: Secure Server Environment Plan, Build & Documentation
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: NET-2220 course build; maps to PLO 1, PLO 3

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Deploy and manage server roles, network services, storage, virtualization, backup, recovery, and other infrastructure components required for reliable and secure enterprise operations.
COURSE_CLOS.Assessment Method: Capstone: Secure Server Environment Plan, Build & Documentation
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: NET-2220 course build; maps to PLO 1

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Monitor, analyze, and troubleshoot server performance, availability, security, services, and connectivity using systematic diagnostic methods, logs, administrative tools, and appropriate automation.
COURSE_CLOS.Assessment Method: Capstone: Secure Server Environment Plan, Build & Documentation
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: NET-2220 course build; maps to PLO 4

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Use scripting, automation, and AI-assisted administration tools responsibly to support monitoring, configuration, troubleshooting, documentation, and operational tasks while independently validating recommended actions before implementation.
COURSE_CLOS.Assessment Method: Capstone: Secure Server Environment Plan, Build & Documentation
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: NET-2220 course build; maps to PLO 4, PLO 5

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Plan, implement, document, and evaluate a secure server environment that integrates identity, services, virtualization or cloud infrastructure, security controls, monitoring, and recovery while communicating technical findings and administrative recommendations professionally.
COURSE_CLOS.Assessment Method: Capstone: Secure Server Environment Plan, Build & Documentation
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: NET-2220 course build; maps to PLO 1, PLO 6

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Analyze network traffic across protocol layers to distinguish normal behavior from anomalous or malicious activity within enterprise network environments.
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: CYBR-2200 course build; maps to PLO 2, PLO 3

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Apply flow monitoring and traffic-capture techniques, using AI-assisted anomaly triage as an initial analysis step with independent verification of findings, to detect potential intrusions and indicators of compromise.
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: CYBR-2200 course build; maps to PLO 2, PLO 3

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Investigate and correlate captured traffic, flow data, and log artifacts to determine likely attack vectors, scope, and impact.
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: CYBR-2200 course build; maps to PLO 2, PLO 4

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Recommend and justify mitigation strategies based on traffic-analysis findings, evaluating tradeoffs within a security operations context.
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: CYBR-2200 course build; maps to PLO 3, PLO 4

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Communicate traffic-analysis findings through professional reports and visualizations tailored to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: CYBR-2200 course build; maps to PLO 6

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Select, configure, and critically evaluate the output of industry-standard traffic-capture and monitoring tools (e.g., Wireshark, TCPdump, flow-monitoring platforms), rather than treating tool operation as an end in itself.
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: CYBR-2200 course build; maps to PLO 4

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Reconnaissance and Vulnerability Assessment: Perform active and passive reconnaissance, including AI-assisted reconnaissance tools with independent verification of findings, to gather information about systems, networks, and vulnerabilities, and utilize tools to identify, classify, and prioritize them.
COURSE_CLOS.Assessment Method: Ridgeline Full Penetration Test and Compliance Report
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: CYBR-2201 course build; maps to PLO 3, PLO 4

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Exploitation and Post-Exploitation: Demonstrate ethical exploitation techniques and conduct post-exploitation activities such as privilege escalation, lateral movement, and maintaining persistence within legal and ethical guidelines.
COURSE_CLOS.Assessment Method: Ridgeline Full Penetration Test and Compliance Report
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: CYBR-2201 course build; maps to PLO 3, PLO 5

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Tool Proficiency: Configure, effectively use, and critically evaluate the output of tools such as Metasploit, Burp Suite, Wireshark, PowerShell, and AI-assisted analysis tools to conduct penetration testing and vulnerability assessments.
COURSE_CLOS.Assessment Method: Ridgeline Full Penetration Test and Compliance Report
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: CYBR-2201 course build; maps to PLO 4

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Compliance and Reporting: Prepare comprehensive penetration testing reports in adherence to industry standards and compliance frameworks, including PCI-DSS, NIST, and GDPR.
COURSE_CLOS.Assessment Method: Ridgeline Full Penetration Test and Compliance Report
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: CYBR-2201 course build; maps to PLO 3, PLO 6

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Defensive Countermeasures: Recommend and implement defensive strategies to mitigate vulnerabilities and enhance overall system security.
COURSE_CLOS.Assessment Method: Ridgeline Full Penetration Test and Compliance Report
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: CYBR-2201 course build; maps to PLO 3

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Ethical and Professional Standards: Apply and justify legal, ethical, and professional standards throughout all phases of penetration testing and cybersecurity practices, including scope adherence and rules of engagement.
COURSE_CLOS.Assessment Method: Ridgeline Full Penetration Test and Compliance Report
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: CYBR-2201 course build; maps to PLO 5

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Demonstrate proficiency in applying core cybersecurity concepts to hands-on environments.
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: CYBR-2600 course build; maps to PLO 3, PLO 4

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Perform and document common defensive and investigative tasks using industry-recognized tools.
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: CYBR-2600 course build; maps to PLO 3, PLO 4

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Identify, analyze, and report on security events and vulnerabilities.
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: CYBR-2600 course build; maps to PLO 3, PLO 6

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Maintain weekly documentation and reporting logs consistent with workplace expectations.
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: CYBR-2600 course build; maps to PLO 5, PLO 6

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Submit professional, task-oriented reports and summaries for technical and non-technical audiences.
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: CYBR-2600 course build; maps to PLO 6

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Apply ethical and legal considerations in simulated cybersecurity tasks and reporting.
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: CYBR-2600 course build; maps to PLO 5

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Network Design and Implementation: Design and implement secure network architectures that integrate networking, security, and governance competencies developed throughout the program, adhering to industry best practices.
COURSE_CLOS.Assessment Method: Capstone: Final Integrated Project, Report & Board Presentation
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: NET-2650 course build; maps to PLO 1, PLO 3

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Incident Response Simulation: Independently plan and execute a simulated cybersecurity incident response, including detection, containment, eradication, and recovery.
COURSE_CLOS.Assessment Method: Capstone: Final Integrated Project, Report & Board Presentation
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: NET-2650 course build; maps to PLO 3, PLO 4

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Tool Utilization: Apply advanced cybersecurity tools—including SIEM systems, intrusion-detection systems, penetration-testing frameworks, and AI-assisted security-analysis platforms—to monitor and secure networks, independently validating AI-generated findings before acting on them.
COURSE_CLOS.Assessment Method: Capstone: Final Integrated Project, Report & Board Presentation
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: NET-2650 course build; maps to PLO 2, PLO 4, PLO 5

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Compliance and Policy Creation: Develop cybersecurity policies that align with industry standards and compliance frameworks, including PCI DSS, NIST, and GDPR.
COURSE_CLOS.Assessment Method: Capstone: Final Integrated Project, Report & Board Presentation
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: NET-2650 course build; maps to PLO 3, PLO 5

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Collaboration and Communication: Collaborate within a team to plan, execute, and present a comprehensive cybersecurity project effectively.
COURSE_CLOS.Assessment Method: Capstone: Final Integrated Project, Report & Board Presentation
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: NET-2650 course build; maps to PLO 5, PLO 6

COURSE_CLOS.CLO Statement: Professional Reporting: Produce clear, professional reports and presentations—including a finalized professional portfolio—that document methodologies, findings, and recommendations for technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
COURSE_CLOS.Assessment Method: Capstone: Final Integrated Project, Report & Board Presentation
COURSE_CLOS.Source / Approval: NET-2650 course build; maps to PLO 6
